answer: Split-tally bond stops bulk fakes: a tally split in two, a shard sealed in violet wax, its match on the registry. The sealed half rests in a dune cache, key-locked to its owner. An ember audit draws a tally and demands both; mismatch, a reused half, or a borrowed shard burns the bond. k-th 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented tallies fail: one key, five max. Honest agents file once, pay 40, keep the bond.
